operation.summary: Remembered devices on the phone's current network, the same payload as GET /v1/lan/discovered; no scan, no switch needed (like the phone's Network devices screen). For the owner's Bridgit app on iPhone & iPad, over the relay; read-only.

query.name: client
query.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

operation.returns: the GET /v1/lan/discovered payload: total_devices, connected_devices, unconnected_devices, categories, devices; every brand logo_url points at GET /v1/portal/brands/{id}/logo; plus added: the devices added to Bridgit (id, name, host, kind, state, applets, checks; no credentials)

client.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it
